items.name: Scope matches request
items.note: Relative image src in SmartViewer markdown now resolves via the file route; all image types (svg/png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp) share one path.

items.name: No dead code / debug
items.note: 3 source files + 1 unit test file + 1 E2E spec; no leftovers.

items.name: Error/edge paths
items.note: Absolute URLs untouched; no resolver (Mission/Compliance hosts) keeps src as written; ../ clamped at root by resolveDocPath; %20 decoded per segment.

items.name: Tests
items.note: 6-ext unit matrix, ../ + encoded name, session route, absolute, no-resolver; E2E asserts naturalWidth>0 for svg+png on the real file route. Full vitest 5164 pass.

items.name: Conventions / file size
items.note: DocumentMarkdown ~265 lines, MarkdownRenderer ~145; under 300, no bloat entry.

items.name: Security / data
items.note: Resolved URL is the existing project file route (path-guarded, MIME allowlist, nosniff+sandbox CSP); SVG loads via so scripts do not run; sanitizer unchanged.

items.name: Affected boundaries
items.note: Outside-project docs use the session-file route; unevidenced siblings 403 and show a broken image (assetOf only supports html owners) - documented limitation.
